headline: I-Med Reaches Extrajudicial Settlement with FNE, Agreeing to US$4 Million Payment
summary: Chile's FNE and I-Med reached an extrajudicial agreement incorporating a US$4 million payment and the elimination of restrictive contract clauses to protect free competition in healthcare technology platforms.
why: Antitrust settlements involving regulatory bodies ensure open competition in digital healthcare intermediation and electronic medical licensing markets.

impacts.why: Regulatory settlement and financial penalties directly impact corporate cash reserves.
